title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 10 — WORLD 8: C2 MEDIA INTELLIGENCE, DIGITAL LITERACY & GLOBAL COMMUNICATION
grammar: Advanced information structure for emphasis, contrast, correction, and controlled focus
Complex reported speech and stance reporting for interviews, journalism, commentary, and digital communication
Modal and semi-modal expressions for certainty, doubt, obligation, prediction, and evaluation
Advanced passive and impersonal constructions for neutral, institutional, and analytical reporting
Conditionals and hypothetical structures for analysing media scenarios, consequences, and alternative interpretations
Ellipsis, substitution, coordination, and discourse reference across extended spoken interaction
Nominalisation, compression, and sentence-level reformulation for headlines, reports, and analytical prose
Pragmatic register control across journalism, social media, professional communication, and public debate

missions.title: Media Intelligence Gateway
missions.focus: Identify how language, structure, visuals, and context influence the interpretation of information.

missions.title: Digital Vocabulary Forge
missions.focus: Master precise vocabulary for journalism, platforms, algorithms, audiences, information quality, and online behaviour.

missions.title: Headline Decoder Observatory
missions.focus: Analyse compressed headlines, framing choices, ambiguity, omission, and the effect of word selection.

missions.title: Source Credibility Lab
missions.focus: Evaluate source quality by examining evidence, expertise, transparency, corroboration, and limitations.

missions.title: Newsroom Listening Command
missions.focus: Interpret reports, interviews, panels, and commentary while distinguishing fact, interpretation, and speculation.

missions.title: Framing & Perspective Reactor
missions.focus: Compare different presentations of the same event and identify how framing changes emphasis and interpretation.

missions.title: Fact-Claim Separation Chamber
missions.focus: Distinguish verifiable statements from opinions, predictions, interpretations, and unsupported assertions.

missions.title: Algorithm Awareness Portal
missions.focus: Discuss how recommendation systems, ranking signals, and audience behaviour can shape information exposure.

missions.title: Interview Analysis Arena
missions.focus: Analyse questioning strategies, evasive answers, clarification, interruption, tone, and implied meaning in interviews.

missions.title: Digital Argument Nexus
missions.focus: Construct and evaluate complex arguments in online discussions while maintaining evidence and pragmatic control.

missions.title: Misinformation Response Simulator
missions.focus: Respond to questionable information by checking claims, expressing uncertainty, and communicating corrections responsibly.

missions.title: Global Media Comparison Lab
missions.focus: Compare coverage from different outlets or audiences and explain differences in emphasis, terminology, and context.

missions.title: Visual Data Narrative Studio
missions.focus: Explain charts, graphics, captions, and visual narratives while identifying misleading or incomplete interpretations.

missions.title: Public Commentary Observatory
missions.focus: Analyse persuasive commentary and distinguish rhetorical force, evidence, assumption, and emotional framing.

missions.title: Investigative Report Forge
missions.focus: Write a structured analytical report that organises evidence, source limitations, competing explanations, and conclusions.

missions.title: Responsible Digital Communication Lab
missions.focus: Rewrite sensitive information for public communication using accuracy, context, respectful language, and appropriate qualification.

missions.title: Media Ethics Decision Arena
missions.focus: Evaluate difficult communication choices involving privacy, public interest, accuracy, speed, and potential harm.

missions.title: Global Media Briefing Command
missions.focus: Deliver a balanced briefing on a complex information environment and answer challenging audience questions.

missions.title: Integrated Media Intelligence Quest
missions.focus: Combine reading, listening, source evaluation, writing, vocabulary, grammar, and spontaneous speaking in one digital-media scenario.

missions.title: C2 Media Intelligence Master Challenge
missions.focus: Complete an advanced global communication challenge demonstrating precise, critical, ethical, and audience-aware C2 English.

realWorldScenarios.title: International Newsroom
realWorldScenarios.description: Analyse a developing story, compare source reliability, identify uncertainty, prepare a balanced briefing, and answer editorial questions.

realWorldScenarios.title: Digital Information Crisis
realWorldScenarios.description: Assess a rapidly spreading claim, separate evidence from speculation, formulate a responsible correction, and explain the reasoning to a public audience.

realWorldScenarios.title: Global Media Strategy Room
realWorldScenarios.description: Adapt the same complex information for executives, journalists, and the general public while preserving accuracy and essential context.

assessment.type: Integrated C2 media intelligence, digital literacy, and global communication assessment
successCriteria: precise and flexible C2 communication control
accurate distinction between fact, interpretation, and speculation
critical analysis of framing and source quality
responsible communication of uncertainty and corrections
